segments.name: Commerce platform
segments.description: Runs an all-in-one commerce platform that lets merchants of all sizes sell online, in store and everywhere in between.
segments.evidence: Shopify's all-in-one platform makes it easier to start, run and grow a business, powering sales online, in store, and everywhere in between.

revenueModel.text: Merchants pay recurring subscription fees for platform plans and pay merchant solutions fees for payments, lending, shipping and advertising.
revenueModel.evidence: Our business model has two revenue components: a recurring subscription component that we call subscription solutions and a merchant success-based component that we call merchant solutions.

changes.text: In 2023 Shopify sold its logistics businesses, the majority to Flexport.
changes.evidence: In the second quarter of 2023 the Company sold its logistics businesses (the "divested businesses").
